verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API that covers "much of the data in the system", with item listing and filtering endpoints, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec tagged Item/Occurrence/Metrics/Deploy, and a Terraform provider for project setup. The vendor's own wording ("much of") and the narrow resource tags show the API does not match everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage of UI actions such as custom fingerprinting rules, item merging, notification and integration configuration, and data-retention settings, and independent confirmation of how far the API reaches.
